title: Jephthah the Deliverer

questions.question: Who was Jephthah's father?
questions.explanation: Judges 11:1 (ESV): "Jephthah... was the son of a prostitute. Gilead was the father of Jephthah."

questions.question: Why did Jephthah's brothers drive him out?
options: You shall not have an inheritance in our father's house, for you are the son of another woman
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not have an inheritance in our father's house, for you are the son of another woman
questions.explanation: Judges 11:2 (ESV): "...'You shall not have an inheritance in our father's house, for you are the son of another woman.'"

questions.question: Who asked Jephthah to come back and lead them?
questions.explanation: Judges 11:5 (ESV): "...the elders of Gilead went to bring Jephthah from the land of Tob."

questions.question: What vow did Jephthah make?
options: Whatever comes out from the doors of my house to meet me... shall be the Lord's, and I will offer it as a burnt offering
I will give all my money
questions.correctAnswer: Whatever comes out from the doors of my house to meet me... shall be the Lord's, and I will offer it as a burnt offering
questions.explanation: Judges 11:31 (ESV): "...then whatever comes out from the doors of my house to meet me... shall be the LORD's, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering."

questions.question: Who came out to meet Jephthah?
questions.explanation: Judges 11:34 (ESV): "...behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances."

questions.question: Where did Jephthah flee to when his brothers drove him out?
questions.explanation: Judges 11:3 (ESV): "Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob..."

questions.question: What negotiation did Jephthah try first with the King of Ammon?
options: Sent messengers to ask why he was attacking
questions.correctAnswer: Sent messengers to ask why he was attacking
questions.explanation: Judges 11:12 (ESV): "Then Jephthah sent messengers into the king of the Ammonites..."

questions.question: What was the King of Ammon's complaint?
options: Israel took away my land when they came up from Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Israel took away my land when they came up from Egypt
questions.explanation: Judges 11:13 (ESV): "...Because Israel on coming up from Egypt took away my land..."

questions.question: How did Jephthah respond to the land dispute?
options: He recounted history showing Israel did not take the land by force but God gave it
questions.correctAnswer: He recounted history showing Israel did not take the land by force but God gave it
questions.explanation: Judges 11:15-27 (ESV): Jephthah gives a detailed historical defense.

questions.question: What did Jephthah's daughter ask for before the vow was fulfilled?
options: Two months to wander on the mountains and weep for her virginity
questions.correctAnswer: Two months to wander on the mountains and weep for her virginity
questions.explanation: Judges 11:37 (ESV): "...let me alone two months, that I may go up and down on the mountains and weep for my virginity..."

questions.question: How long had Israel occupied the disputed land (Heshbon, Aroer, etc.)?
questions.explanation: Judges 11:26 (ESV): "While Israel lived in Heshbon... for 300 years..."

questions.question: Who is Chemosh mentioned as?
questions.explanation: Judges 11:24 (ESV): "Will you not possess what Chemosh your god gives you to possess?"

questions.question: What happened in the Spirit of the Lord regarding Jephthah?
options: The Spirit of the Lord was upon Jephthah
It gave him strength like Samson
questions.correctAnswer: The Spirit of the Lord was upon Jephthah
questions.explanation: Judges 11:29 (ESV): "Then the Spirit of the LORD was upon Jephthah..."

questions.question: Who gathered around Jephthah in Tob?
questions.explanation: Judges 11:3 (ESV): "...and worthless fellows collected around Jephthah and went out with him."

questions.question: What became a custom in Israel?
options: The daughters of Israel went year by year to lament the daughter of Jephthah four days in the year
questions.correctAnswer: The daughters of Israel went year by year to lament the daughter of Jephthah four days in the year
questions.explanation: Judges 11:39-40 (ESV): "...that the daughters of Israel went year by year to lament the daughter of Jephthah..."

key_verse_text: So then the LORD, the God of Israel, dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel; and are you to take possession of them? (ESV)
